svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Saw a 21 mm slice off 20 mm brass bar; face both ends to 20 mm long.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The two end faces must be flat and parallel: face them in one setting

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: each, or lap them on fine paper on glass.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Mass about 53 g; weigh it and write the figure down.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Break the edges 0.3 mm; degrease with alcohol before bonding.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: bonded with a thin film of rigid epoxy on the brass face of the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: piezo disc, centred, which is bonded to the puck base.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Nothing else touches it: 4.5 mm side gap to the bore and 4.5 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: up to the preamplifier board. No potting below the board.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: 20 mm long, faces parallel within 0.05 mm.
